'''Twin Suns Six''' was the callsign of an unknown [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] within [[Twin Suns Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Bilbringi (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Bilbringi]], Twin Suns Six was sent with [[Twin Suns Five]] and [[Jagged Fel]] to escape the system and find [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].<ref name="FP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>

*''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''
